name: vscode-tm1-ide
displayName: TM1 IDE – IBM Planning Analytics (TurboIntegrator, Rules, MDX)
author: flameY3T1

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Server profiles and credentials live outside the workspace, so a folder cannot redirect them. In Restricted Mode the workspace cannot set the TI test root folder or the native API path.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Requires local file-system access (Git mirror, .pro/.rux/.ti files) and Node networking for the TM1 REST API, which are unavailable in virtual workspaces.

view/item/context.when: (viewItem =~ /^cube(-v12)?(-control)?(-haspick)?(\.loaded|\.unloaded)?$/ || viewItem =~ /^dimension(-control)?$/ || viewItem == cubeDimension || viewItem =~ /^hierarchy(-control)?$/ || viewItem =~ /^process($|\.git$)/ || viewItem == chore) && !listMultiSelection

(viewItem =~ /^process($|\.git$)/ || viewItem == chore || viewItem =~ /^cube(-v12)?(-control)?(-haspick)?(\.loaded|\.unloaded)?$/ || viewItem =~ /^dimension(-control)?$/ || viewItem == cubeDimension || viewItem =~ /^hierarchy(-control)?$/) && !listMultiSelection

(viewItem =~ /^process($|\.git$)/ || viewItem =~ /^processGroup(\.grouped)?$/ || viewItem =~ /^cube(-v12)?(-control)?(-haspick)?(\.loaded|\.unloaded)?$/ || viewItem =~ /^cubeRule($|\.git$)/ || viewItem == cubeView || viewItem == cubeDimension || viewItem =~ /^dimension(-control)?$/ || viewItem =~ /^hierarchy(-control)?$/ || viewItem == attribute || viewItem == subset || viewItem == chore) && !listMultiSelection

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run lint:dead && npm run lint:promises && npm run compile && npm test && npm run lint:deps
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p ./ --noEmit && tsc -p src/webviewClient/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p src/test-integration/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p src/test/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run compile && node scripts/check-bundle.cjs
scripts.test:integration: npm run compile && tsc -p src/test-integration/tsconfig.json && vscode-test
scripts.lint:deps:graph: depcruise --config .dependency-cruiser.js --output-type dot src | dot -T svg -o deps.svg
